title:
Little by Little,
Not All at Once
paragraphs: Israel stood at the edge of Canaan staring at nations bigger than they were, and God didn't promise them an instant country. He promised them a mighty hand, signs they had already seen with their own eyes, and a God who would personally go before them into every fight. Notice what He didn't promise: a shortcut. He promised presence for a process, not an escape from one.

"Little and little" sounds unimpressive until you remember it's the same method God has used on every giant He's ever brought down. He could hand you the whole victory in a single afternoon, but He builds something in you on the way there that a shortcut would skip entirely — faith that's been tested, not just told it would work. So don't measure this season by how far you still have to go. Measure it by the hand that's been moving you forward this whole time, one little and little at a time.
